Rate Schedules and Policies
NB Power’s electricity rates are among the lowest in the Maritimes. One of our goals is to keep rates low and stable for our customers now, and in the future.
You can find rate information for your home
here
.
Looking for rate information for your business? You can find that
here
.
Policies
NB Power is required to file with the Energy and Utilities Board schedules showing all charges, rates and tolls NB Power has established for any service performed within the Province of New Brunswick.
The Rate Schedules and Policies Manual
defines the scope and application of policies and electricity rates for NB Power service areas in the Province of New Brunswick. NB Power is required to file with the Energy and Utilities Board schedules showing all charges, rates and tolls NB Power has established for any service performed within the Province of New Brunswick.
NB Power reserves the right to change items in this manual that do not alter any of the charges, rates and tolls subject to the Electricity Act.
Revised:
April 7, 2026
Effective Date:
April 14, 2026

During this time, you may have missing information or estimates in your online usage graph. Some bills may be estimated. Any differences will be fixed automatically once actual meter data is received. The meter will continue to measure your energy use correctly. Your electricity service will not be affected.

Net Zero Rate Program
Clean energy at an optional premium rate
The Net Zero Rate Program is designed for customers who want to contribute to the reduction of electricity-related emissions, without installing or operating their own generation assets.
Through this optional program, NB Power customers can pay a premium rate to indicate their preference to receive a portion of their electricity from clean, non-emitting energy sources.
Offered on a first-come, first-served basis and subject to availability, the Net Zero Rate Program provides a quick and convenient way to support measurable progress toward carbon reduction and climate goals, while continuing to receive safe, reliable electricity service from NB Power.
Why choose the Net Zero Rate
The Net Zero Rate Program offers a fast, low-risk, and cost-effective way to support carbon reduction goals with no capital investment, no infrastructure risk, and minimal operational impact, while helping you demonstrate leadership in sustainability and climate action.
Benefits
Climate action leadership
Provide a clear pathway to emissions reductions and climate commitments.
No capital investment
Support reduction in emissions without investing in on-site generation, equipment, or upgrades. A predictable, transparent premium supports carbon reduction goals without long-term capital or market exposure.
No infrastructure risk​
NB Power manages generation and reliability. There is no asset ownership, maintenance, or performance risk.
Simple and convenient​
No changes to how electricity is delivered or used. Easy to implement across single sites or large portfolios.
Fast and cost-effective​
Avoid multi-year projects, permitting, and construction. Participation begins once enrolled.​
How the Net Zero Rate Program Works
NB Power’s electricity system is approximately 75% non-emitting, using a mix of renewable and nuclear generation. Through the Net Zero Rate Program, customers can subscribe to the remaining portion of their electricity use to match their total consumption with clean energy supplied by NB Power.
The Net Zero Rate Program allows customers to support the reduction of electricity-related emissions by supporting the generation and sourcing of clean energy by NB Power, without the need for customers to install their own generation equipment.
Here’s how participation works:
Select your participation level to indicate your preferred portion of clean, non-emitting energy you want for your electricity use (up to 100%), subject to availability.
A Net Zero Rate premium applies only to the participation level you select.
Your existing electricity rate remains unchanged.
The Net Zero Rate premium appears as a separate line item on your bill: Net Zero Premium.
Participation is voluntary and available to all customer rate classes, subject to program availability.
Premium Rates:
The Net Zero Rate is shown as a separate line item on your electricity bill.
Distribution customers:
8.32 cents per kWh
Applicable taxes ap
[DOC 4] https://www.nbpower.com/en/products-services/net-zero-rate-program
ply.
Transmission customers:
7.99 cents per kWh
Applicable taxes apply.
How the new non emitting energy premium is calculated:
Your total electricity consumption in kWh
The participation level you choose to enroll in the Net Zero Rate Program
Eligibility:
Participation is offered on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to availability, and is subject to program
Terms and Conditions
.
Ready to get started?
Review the
Terms and Conditions
and complete the Enquiry Form to express your interest in the Net Zero Rate Program. Submissions are reviewed for eligibility and program availability, and participation is not guaranteed. Eligible customers are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis while capacity remains available.
Enquiry Form
Looking to generate your own renewable energy instead?
NB Power’s Net Metering Program may be a better fit if you want to install renewable generation at your home or business.
Learn more about the
Net Metering Program
.

We’re upgrading our systems.
During this time, you may have missing information or estimates in your online usage graph. Some bills may be estimated. Any differences will be fixed automatically once actual meter data is received. The meter will continue to measure your energy use correctly. Your electricity service will not be affected.

Net Zero Rate Program

Terms and Conditions
These Terms and Conditions (the “Terms and Conditions”) govern NB Power’s Net Zero Rate Program (the “Program”) under which the Net Zero Rate Rider (the “Net Zero Rate”) is applied as a premium to eligible Customer bills.
Definitions:
“Agreement” means the Enrollment Form, together with the Terms and Conditions, and any document incorporated expressly therein by reference.
“Account” means the Customer’s NB Power account, as identified by the NB Power Account Number provided on the Enrollment Form.
“Customer” means 
[DOC 6] https://www.nbpower.com/en/products-services/net-zero-rate-program/terms-and-conditions
an individual, partnership, organization, corporation, institution, or business that is receiving or has received electrical energy or electrical services in New Brunswick from NB Power, that has enrolled in the Program.
“Enquiry Form” means the Program enquiry form submitted by the Customer to NB Power.
“Enrolment Form” means the Program enrollment form submitted by the Customer to NB Power.
“Net Zero Rate” has the meaning given to that term in Section 1 hereof.
“Terms and Conditions” has the meaning given to that term in Section 1 hereof.
“Participation Level” means the percentage of the Customer’s electricity supply that the Customer selects for enrollment in the Program, as specified on the Enrollment Form.
“Party” or “Parties” means individually and/or collectively NB Power and/or the Customer.
“Program” has the meaning given to that term in Section 1 hereof.
To be eligible for the Program, the Customer must elect to participate in the Program, meet all eligibility criteria identified herein, and have their participation accepted by NB Power.
The Customer understands and acknowledges that participation in the Program is voluntary and is not a condition of receiving electric service from NB Power.
The Customer understands and agrees that submission of an Enquiry Form and/or the Enrollment Form does not constitute acceptance into the Program. Enrollment shall be effective only upon acceptance by NB Power and implementation in NB Power’s billing system.
The Customer understands and agrees that participation in the Program shall be available on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to Program availability and capacity limitations.
The Customer understands and acknowledges that, in order to be eligible for participation in the Program, the Account must be in good standing at all times. For the purposes of these Terms and Conditions, an Account is “in good standing” if it is active, not subject to disconnection, and all undisputed amounts owing are paid when due.
The Customer represents and warrants that the Account is in good standing as at the date of enrollment and will remain in good standing during participation in the Program. If, in NB Power’s opinion, the Account is not, or is no longer, in good standing, NB Power may suspend the Customer’s participation in the Program and/or terminate participation effective immediately.
The Net Zero Rate shall be charged as a per-kilowatt-hour premium and shall appear as a separate line item on the Customer’s bill, subject to applicable taxes. Base Rate for the Net Zero Rate for FY 2026/27 is 8.32 cents/kWh for distribution Customers and 7.99 cents/kWh for transmission Customers. The Customer understands and agrees that the Base Rate is subject to change, such changes will be reflected on NB Power’s
website
and shall be incorporated by reference herein.
The Customer understands and acknowledges that a minimum charge of $8.32 per billing period will be applied to accounts using less than 100kWh to cov
[DOC 6] https://www.nbpower.com/en/products-services/net-zero-rate-program/terms-and-conditions
er administrative costs.  The Customer understands and agrees that minimum charge is subject to change and applicable taxes, such changes will be reflected on NB Power’s
website
and shall be incorporated by reference herein.
NB Power will use best efforts to follow auditing and reporting processes similar to those that are required for the Renewable Portfolio Standard.
Given that non-emitting/clean electricity is subject to availability and cannot be dispatched on demand, NB Power cannot guarantee that the physical delivery of electricity will be sourced from non-emitting/clean resources. The Customer understands and agrees that participation in the Program does not alter the physical delivery of electricity and does not guarantee that electricity supplied to the Customer is generated from any specific generating source.
NB Power makes no representation, warranty, or guarantee, and shall have no liability, regarding the eligibility, recognition, or treatment of the Customer’s participation in the Program under any Customer or third-party environmental, emissions, sustainability, or similar reporting standards, legislation, regulation, or other directive.
The Customer understands and acknowledges that energy usage graph (current year vs previous year) on their NB Power bill will not be impacted by their participation in the Program.
The Customer understands and agrees that, if the Customer participates in equalized billing, the Customer’s equalized bill will increase to reflect the Net Zero Rate.
The Agreement shall automatically renew on a month-to-month basis unless terminated by either Party upon at least 30 days’ written notice.
The Customer may request changes to their Participation Level or withdraw from the Program upon 30 days notice in writing to NB Power, subject to administrative and billing constraints. The Customer understands and agrees that NB Power will require a minimum of 30 days to process any such requested change or withdrawal.
NB Power reserves the right to amend, suspend, or terminate the Program without prior notice to the Customer.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, NB Power reserves the right to terminate the Agreement at any time without notice if the Customer fails to comply with the terms of the Agreement or if the Customer no longer meets the eligibility criteria under the Program. The Customer shall advise NB Power immediately if the Customer ceases to meet the eligibility criteria. If the Agreement is terminated by NB Power for breach of the Agreement by Customer, the Customer shall be responsible for payment of all costs associated with such termination.
Except as required by law, NB Power shall not be liable for any losses arising from or relating to the Customer’s participation in the Program.
NB Power shall not be liable to the Customer for, or be considered to be in breach of or default under the Agreement because of, any failure or delay in performance by NB Power under the Agreement to the extent such failure or 
[DOC 6] https://www.nbpower.com/en/products-services/net-zero-rate-program/terms-and-conditions
delay is caused by or results from any such cause or condition which is beyond NB Power’s reasonable control, or which such NB Power is unable to prevent or overcome by exercise of reasonable diligence (any such cause or conditions, a “Force Majeure”), including breach of contract or failure of performance by any person providing services to NB Power.
The Customer understands and agrees that
NB Power’s Rate Schedules and Policies Manual
and any amendments thereto shall apply to the Program, the contents of which are incorporated by reference and shall form an integral part of the Agreement. Any capitalized terms used herein and not defined shall have the meaning ascribed to such term in NB Power’s Rate Schedules and Policies Manual.
In the event of a conflict, the contents of the Agreement, as supplemented by NB Power’s Rate Schedules and Policies Manual, and governing legislation shall prevail.
The Customer represents and warrants to NB Power that the execution, delivery and performance by it of the Agreement has been duly authorized by all necessary corporate and regulatory action on its part and that the execution, delivery and performance by it of the Agreement does not result in a breach, violation of, or conflict with the terms of any contracts or instruments to which it is a party.
The Parties are, and will at all times remain, independent contractors. The Agreement does not create, and will not be construed in any way as creating, the relationship of joint ventures, partners, associates, principal and agent or any similar or like relationship between the Parties which could give rise to joint and several liability.
If any term of the Agreement is held illegal or unenforceable by a court with jurisdiction over the Agreement, all other terms of the Agreement shall remain in full force, and the illegal or unenforceable provision shall be deemed struck. In the event that the stricken provision materially affects the rights, obligations or duties of either Party, the Parties shall substitute a provision by mutual agreement that preserves the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible under applicable law.
The Customer will, at any time and from time to time, do, execute, acknowledge and deliver or cause to be done, executed, acknowledged and delivered, all such further documents, assurances or things, and secure all necessary consents, as may be reasonably required for the more perfect observance and performance by the Customer of the terms of the Agreement.
Except where otherwise provided, the Agreement is not made for the benefit of any person not a party to the Agreement, and no person other than the Parties or their respective successors and permitted assigns shall acquire or have any right, remedy or claim under or by virtue of the Agreement.
